tagline: Pattaya's captive day-trip island — high-frequency short hop.
summary: Koh Larn sits ~5nm east of Pattaya's Bali Hai Pier and absorbs a constant stream of day-trippers from the Eastern Seaboard. Na Ban Pier is the main landing; speedboats and ferries run throughout the day. It is the cleanest proof corridor for a Grab in-app premium island hop paired with Bangkok/Pattaya gateway demand.

demand_signals.detail: Bali Hai Pier launches high-frequency speedboat/ferry service to Koh Larn throughout the day.
Pattaya absorbs Bangkok leisure traffic; Koh Larn is the default island escape.

use_cases: Pattaya (Bali Hai) <-> Koh Larn premium island transfer
Grab day-trip bundles (GrabCar Bangkok + foiling hop)
navier_fit: High. Short open-water hop; captive day-trip demand; pairs with Pattaya marina infrastructure and Bangkok gateway narrative.
competitive_landscape: Conventional speedboats only; no premium electric scheduled tier.
signature_routes: Bali Hai Pier <-> Na Ban Pier (Koh Larn)

grab.super_app_fit: In-app Pattaya day-trip bundles from Bangkok; premium island hop in the Grab wallet.
grab.wedge: Proves the gulf gateway story with a short, high-frequency corridor before long Bangkok↔Samui legs.

transit_planning.note: Mainland gateway is Bali Hai Pier (pattaya-thailand).

_enrichment.note: Minted from Bucket-C; paired with Pattaya anchor.
